description:
You are a radiologist preparing a multi-tissue 3D anatomical model for a neurosurgery team's pre-operative review. The CT Cranium DICOM series is already loaded in InVesalius 3. Output files should go into /home/ga/Documents/tissue_exports/ (directory already created).

Create three separate segmentation masks and export a 3D surface mesh for each:
1. Full bone tissue mask (Hounsfield threshold minimum must be at or above 226 HU to capture all bone) → generate surface → export to /home/ga/Documents/tissue_exports/bone_tissue.stl
2. Compact cortical bone mask (Hounsfield threshold minimum at or above 662 HU to isolate only dense cortical bone) → generate surface → export to /home/ga/Documents/tissue_exports/compact_bone.stl
3. Soft tissue mask (Hounsfield threshold maximum at or below 225 HU to capture soft tissue excluding bone) → generate surface → export to /home/ga/Documents/tissue_exports/soft_tissue.stl

Save the complete project (with all three masks and all three surfaces) to /home/ga/Documents/tissue_exports/tissue_analysis.inv3
